response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(si.riskeval),''),'__none__') AS grp, SUM(s.gbsize)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(s.spanmin),0) AS rate FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref GROUP BY 1), b AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS bench FROM g WHERE rate IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(g.rate - b.bench) AS avg_margin FROM g, b WHERE g.rate > b.bench
